title: 第21章 神兽择主求追读第20章 变心求追读
slug: 恶毒女配又装纯禁欲大佬皆沦陷
content_zh:
和铃怎么可能变心呢？
这么多年了，不管夜弦对她如何冷漠无情，和铃都是眼巴巴地捧着宝物自己求着夜弦收的。
她觉得夜弦被和铃感动的可能性都比和铃变心的可能性大。
反正梁秋儿是不相信自己妹妹的话的。
小麒麟歪着脑袋打了个哈欠。
圆润的水灵灵的眼睛偷瞄了和铃一眼。
这些天的晚上，一直有南华宗的弟子来给它送吃的，但它却再也没有见到和铃。
她是不想得到自己的青睐了吗？
居然只讨好它一次就不来了。
哼。
待会儿它一定要吓唬吓唬她。
小麒麟这样想着，脸上露出一丝鬼鬼祟祟的微笑。
“你们看，小麒麟居然笑了。”
“它不会要选择程芰荷了吧？”
“小麒麟糊涂啊！程芰荷无才无貌，现在又和凡人无异，它怎么会看上程芰荷呢？”
“肯定是那颗麒麟果起作用了，夜弦师弟的无情道不会要破了吧？不然他怎么会给程芰荷麒麟果，让她讨得小麒麟欢心呢？”
“麒麟果是夜师弟和梁师姐从秘境中带回来的，总共都没有几颗，夜师弟能把麒麟果让给程芰荷，还不能说明什么吗？”
“真是没想到，宗门里面这么多的女弟子，居然都输给了程芰荷，显得和铃这些年的死皮赖脸甚是可笑啊！”
和铃好烦。
这些人能不能不要老是提以前的事情了。

原身喜欢过夜弦真要成她一辈子的污点了。
可恶啊。
好想给大家都灌一点失去记忆的药。
程芰荷感觉到小麒麟有些在发呆，都没有听她说什么。
但小麒麟收下了她的麒麟果，歪着脑袋咬了起来。
她回头看了眼小麒麟，茫然地下了台。
姜暮烟上台前，和铃给她打气，“师姐加油，你能行的！”
姜暮烟笑了笑，“阿铃不是想要小麒麟当坐骑吗？我若是行了，你怎么办？”
和铃一脸正色地说道：“我只是觉得小麒麟便宜了外人很可惜，不如给我。但师姐不是外人，如果小麒麟认了师姐为主，一点不可惜。”
姜暮烟很感动和铃能说这番话。
她上了麒麟台，走了个过场，很快结束。
接下来是张流川、第五齐，两人都没有在麒麟台呆很久。
轮到和铃的时候，她拍了拍衣袖，潇潇洒洒走上台，还未靠近小麒麟，小麒麟忽地怒吼一声，喷出一团浓墨。
她头上的簪子迸射一缕金光，化作光墙，挡下小麒麟的攻击。
吕温良说道：“小麒麟抵抗的情绪有些强烈，和铃，你先下去吧。”
和铃瞪了小麒麟一眼，分明看见它眼里的戏谑和故意。
回到队伍中，姜暮烟关心地问道：“阿铃你没事吧？这只玄墨麒麟脾气不好，咱不要它了，等下次师姐下秘境，给你捉只更好的坐骑回来。”
张流川眼睛一亮，“师姐，我也要。”
姜暮烟给他一个眼神让他自己分辨，张流川嘿嘿两声，连忙道：“我不要了，不要了。”
大家在底下静静地等着。
content_en:
How could He Ling change her mind?
After so many years, no matter how indifferent Ye Xian was to her, He Ling eagerly held the treasure and begged Ye Xian to take it.
She felt that the possibility of Ye Xian being moved by He Ling was greater than the possibility of He Ling changing her heart.
Anyway, Liang Qiuer didn't believe what his sister said.
Little Qilin tilted his head and yawned.
Her round, watery eyes glanced at He Ling.
In the evenings these days, disciples from the Nanhua Sect kept coming to bring it food, but it never saw He Ling again.
Doesn't she want to be favored by herself?
Actually, I only flattered it once and then stopped coming.
snort.
It must scare her later.
Little Qilin thought so, with a sneaky smile on his face.
"Look, little Qilin actually smiled."
"It won't choose Cheng Zhihe, right?"
"Little Qilin is confused! Cheng Qianhe has no talent or appearance, and now he is no different from a mortal. How could it like Cheng Qianhe?"
"The Kirin Fruit must have worked. Junior Brother Yexian's ruthlessness will be broken, right? Otherwise, how could he give Cheng Qianhe the Kirin Fruit to please her little Kirin?"
"Junior Brother Ye and Senior Sister Liang brought the Kirin Fruit back from the secret realm. There are only a few in total. Junior Brother Ye can give up the Kirin Fruit to Cheng Qianhe. Doesn't that mean something?"
"I really didn't expect that so many female disciples in the sect would actually lose to Cheng Qianhe. It seems ridiculous that He Ling has been so shameless over the years!"
He Ling is so annoying.
Can these people stop mentioning things from the past all the time?
The original person's liking for Ye Xian will be a stain on her life.
Damn it.
I really want to give everyone some medicine to lose their memory.
Cheng Xianhe felt that Xiao Qilin was in a daze and didn't even listen to what she said.
But the little Qilin accepted her Qilin fruit, tilted her head and started biting it.
She looked back at Xiao Qilin and walked off the stage in a daze.
Before Jiang Muyan came on stage, He Ling cheered her up, "Come on, senior sister, you can do it!"
Jiang Muyan smiled and said, "Don't Aling want the little Qilin to be a mount? If I can do it, what will you do?"
He Ling said with a serious face: "I just think it's a pity that Xiao Qilin is cheaper than an outsider, so why not give it to me. But Senior Sister is not an outsider. It would not be a pity at all if Xiao Qilin recognizes Senior Sister as his master."
Jiang Muyan was very moved to say this to Ling Neng.
She went up to the Qilin Platform and went through a formality, which ended quickly.
Next came Zhang Liuchuan and Wu Qi, neither of whom stayed at Qilin Terrace for a long time.
When it was He Ling's turn, she patted her sleeves and walked onto the stage gracefully. Before she could get close to the little Qilin, the little Qilin suddenly roared and sprayed out a ball of thick ink.
The hairpin on her head burst out with a ray of golden light and turned into a wall of light, blocking the little Qilin's attack.
Lu Wenliang said: "Little Qilin's resistance is a bit strong. He Ling, please go down first."
He Ling glared at the little Qilin, clearly seeing the joking and intentionality in its eyes.
Returning to the team, Jiang Muyan asked with concern: "A Ling, are you okay? This Xuanmo Qilin has a bad temper. We don't want it anymore. The next time Senior Sister goes to the secret realm, I will catch you a better mount."
Zhang Liuchuan's eyes lit up, "Senior sister, I want it too."
Jiang Muyan gave him a look to let him decide for himself. Zhang Liuchuan heyed twice and said quickly: "I don't want it anymore, I don't want it anymore."
Everyone was waiting quietly below.
